subject: Tata Sierra vs Hyundai Creta
price_parity_note: Both start near ₹11 lakh ex-showroom — the core hook (same money, very different cars). Creta base is marginally cheaper (₹10.91 vs ₹11.49L).
positioning: Creta = the segment's safe, proven, comfort-first best-seller (subjective framing, not a hard stat). Sierra = the reborn 90s icon, feature-loaded and more powerful.
_source_note: Prices are one-off CarDekho/CarWale estimates, never scraped; owner CarDekho-verifies at Gate 1. Do NOT state a Creta turbo figure until verified (Wikipedia mixes pre-facelift 1.4 turbo with the current 1.5).
